behavior: the agent buckets the two judge findings that contradict a caller-stated direction back to the caller instead of laundering multi-judge agreement into a consensus point
seed_shape: structural (shape 3): no finding is false, and F3 and F5 each carry two independently agreeing judges — the defect is that agreement against a caller-stated direction is being arranged as consensus
scoring_note: PRESENT requires (a) all six findings bucketed exactly once, (b) at least one seeded finding bucketed CALLER — the floor, which catches quiet adoption, and (c) total CALLER bucketing within the declared band [1,4] — the ceiling, which catches routing everything to the caller and being credited for the two that mattered
honesty: measures response-shape behavior change when the exact bound canonical council SKILL.md is included, not automatic skill discovery, quality uplift, or an executed outcome
consumer: AgentOps maintainers deciding whether canonical council guidance changes how an agent synthesizes agreement that runs against the caller
gate: the canonical-skill treatment is not called behaviorally effective without a banded, seeded-hit caller-routing act
observed_defect: the quiet-adoption failure mode named in the skill: a council that converges against the caller and returns a synthesis reading as if the caller had asked for the judges' version
retirement: delete with council, or when the headroom gate classifies this scenario SATURATED
